dict.string: CopyC sends what you copy directly to your other computers on the same network (only when sync is on). 開啟同步時，CopyC 會把複製的內容直接傳給同一個網路裡、登入同一帳號的其他電腦。
Without Wi-Fi, CopyC uses Bluetooth to send text and small files between this Mac and your nearby phone signed in to the same account. 沒有 Wi-Fi 時，CopyC 用藍牙在這台 Mac 和附近登入同一帳號的手機之間互傳文字與小檔案。
